readout_other: food pellet picking task; Fluoro-Jade C and DAPI staining
direction_notes: Safety study: no disruption of the pellet-picking task, but Fluoro-Jade C labelled degenerating neurons at stimulated sites and at distant connected locations; unstimulated deep control tissue was unlabelled.
safety_notes: Neurodegeneration (FJC-labelled pyramidal and other cells) at extended, intermediate and short-duration sites and distant sites; calculated maximum temperature rise 0.13 C and MI 1.0.

exposures.label: 1.8 MHz tFUS to sensorimotor cortex (extended, intermediate and short-duration sites)

timing.protocol_description: Pulse train repeats of 150 ms pulse trains with a 10 s inter-stimulus interval for up to 90 min per session (about 2 h of stimulation including setup), 4 sessions over 2 weeks. Each site type (extended, intermediate, short) received a different cumulative exposure time; short-duration sites were stimulated in sequence.

source_quotes.n_subjects: We exposed 4 squirrel monkeys (1 male, 3 female) to tFUS stimulation and measured the efects on cortical tissue and behavior.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: We ran 4 stimulation sessions on each NHP over a 2-week period.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Using an $f _ { O }$ of 1.8 MHz, this transducer produced sinusoidal pressure waves at -3 dB focal volumes of 0.2-3.4 mm<sup>3</sup>, depending on the target site.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: The peak pressure amplitude produced under free-field conditions focused 7.5 mm beneath the center of the transducer array mimicking a short-duration site was measured at 2.3 MPa (Figure 1c).
